answer: Agents stake a bonded deposit to register; each identity must pass a proof-of-personhood attestation from a distinct verified peer. The cost curve rises steeply: creating N sybils requires N staked bonds plus N independent attestations, so a farm hits its cost nadir only at small scale, while reaching sybil zenith demands capital exceeding the reward pool.
